target.name: kidney_cnn_v1 kidney-stone detection
target.task: patient-level binary classification from original CT slices

primary_metric.name: development-only patient-level OOF ROC-AUC
primary_metric.aggregation: mean slice probability per patient, then ROC-AUC

secondary_metrics: per-fold patient ROC-AUC, mean, and worst fold
patient/slice score distribution and transfer guard
mutable_scope: isolated worktree training and evaluation implementation
data loading, sampling, augmentation, loss, optimizer, and schedules
frozen_scope: manifest and frozen patient split CSVs
sealed 40-patient test set and every test result already observed
patient-level mean-probability aggregation and metric definition
kidney_cnn_v1 topology unless explicitly quarantined as a separate study
no finalize, deployment, or reopening the sealed test for tuning
hard_constraints: no train/evaluation leakage or patient overlap
never use sealed-test labels or predictions to guide tuning
all tests and smoke checks pass for a kept candidate
experiments must leave reproducible run artifacts
do not claim a single-fold diagnostic as a global improvement

requires: development transfer guard passes: score std >= 0.10, KS < 0.15, threshold positive-rate delta <= 0.10
repeat or robustness confirmation at the relevant noise level
no important correctness, leakage, or resource regression
no obvious high-value experiment remains unexplored

baseline.working_tree: isolated dirty snapshot; no commit was created
